channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: New British frigate enters the water for the first time
item.description: HMS Active, one of the Royal Navy

item.title: L3Harris delivers 100,000 military GPS units
item.description: L3Harris Technologies has delivered more than 100,000 next-generation military GPS receivers to U.S. and allied forces under the Modernised GPS User Equipment (MGUE) Increment 1 programme, the company stated.

item.title: Royal Navy aids French boarding of Russian tanker
item.description: The Royal Navy has supported a French-led operation targeting a sanctioned Russian oil tanker in the Mediterranean, providing tracking and intelligence gathering, the Royal Navy stated.

item.title: Britain and U.S. to develop systems to destroy sea drones
item.description: The United Kingdom and United States are jointly seeking industry solutions to counter a growing class of underwater threats, launching a bilateral programme focused on detecting and defeating uncrewed subsea systems targeting critical infrastructure.

item.title: Starmer insists no delays to Type 83 destroyer
item.description: The Prime Minister has said he is insisting there be no delays to the future Type 83 destroyer programme, amid concern over budget pressures.

item.title: Starmer pushes at high level for Danish Type 31 frigate deal
item.description: Speaking to MPs, Prime Minister Keir Starmer confirmed efforts were ongoing at the highest levels to secure a win for Type 31 in the Danish Frigate competition.

item.title: British destroyer
item.description: Royal Navy destroyer HMS Duncan recently successfully tracked and neutralised multiple drone threats during a live-fire training exercise off the Welsh coast, as part of a QinetiQ-led programme designed to replicate modern warfare conditions.

item.title: Fate of troubled Ajax vehicle to be announced after Easter
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed it has received the final Army safety investigation report into the Ajax armoured vehicle programme, with ministers set to update Parliament on next steps after the Easter recess.

item.title: UK summons Iran ambassador after Faslane entry attempt
item.description: The UK has summoned the Iranian ambassador following the charging of two individuals under national security legislation after an alleged attempt to enter Faslane.

item.title: Defence SME Action Plan to follow Defence Investment Plan
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that work is underway on a new Small and Medium-sized Enterprise (SME) Action Plan, but its publication will be delayed until after the Defence Investment Plan is completed.
